attributes.board_name: New Mexico Board of Veterinary Medicine

rules.accepted_credit_types: Seminars, short courses or scientific programs approved by AAVSB RACE, AVMA or the board, or sponsored by a veterinary medical association, organization or university
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE starts with the next full licensing year after initial New Mexico licensure.
rules.carryover: Up to 15 excess hours may be carried forward to the next licensing year.
rules.audit_note: CE recorded on the renewal form; board may audit. Keep proof at least 4 years.
rules.notes: 15 hours per year in the 12 months before license expiration (license tied to birth month). Non-contact/online max half; management max 5 h/yr; alternative medicine max 11.25 h. Board update: all CE hours may be taken online/virtually through Dec 31, 2026.
